subject: Re: Urgent weekend launch — request for provisional rate cap & smoothing credit
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@fastretail.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Weekend launch — temporary cap request

Jonas — we’re flipping the switch on a targeted weekend promotion next Friday (Dec 18) and traffic projections show a 6–8x spike across our checkout-related endpoints for ~36 hours. Can Redwood provision a temporary rate cap (per-minute qps) and an overage smoothing credit? We’re trying to avoid throttles on the critical purchase flow.

Attached a rough MAP and expected request distribution. We don’t want a long-term contract change, just a provisional protective cap and a reconciliation approach after the week. Happy to sign a short amendment or a scoped SOW.

Thanks,
Maya
Senior Product Manager — FastRetail
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Weekend launch — temporary cap request

Forwarding FastRetail’s ask — they need a one-off provisional rate cap + a smoothing credit for their weekend promo. Key asks: preserve latencies for checkout endpoints, keep their burst within a capped overage rate, and reconcile post-event.

Notes: attach MAP. Maya is okay with a short amendment but expects quick sign-off. Can we outline a proposal that balances finance constraints with product-level priority routing?

— Jonas
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekend launch — temporary cap request

Jonas — I can sign off on a provisional plan if we limit financial exposure and keep the reconciliation simple. Proposed structure: 1) Offer a temporary headroom cap at 10x baseline for 48 hours. 2) Apply an overage smoothing credit up to $7k USD (one-time) to offset excess charges, after which standard overrun rates apply. 3) Require pre-launch telemetry hook and a post-event usage report from FastRetail for quick reconciliation.

Constraints from finance: credits can’t be open-ended and we need a signed amendment with the cap window and an explicit runbook for fallbacks. I’ll push a short contract addendum.

Ben
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 15:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekend launch — temporary cap request

Couple of product/ops guardrails to include in the amendment: 1) Priority routing for two endpoint patterns (/checkout/* and /payments/*) during the window — this ensures KV cache locality and lowers p99. 2) A staged throttling policy: soft limit at 8x baseline with early warnings, hard cap at 12x if we see sustained tail latency degradation. 3) Reconciliation: capture token counts and cost delta; we’ll apply the smoothing credit against the invoice for the billing period and any remainder is billed at the temporary overrun rate.

I’ve drafted suggested language for the amendment and attached a one-page SLA-priority-routing-draft.pdf to use as an exhibit. If legal is cool, we can have an executed amendment + DocuSign link ready by EOD tomorrow.

— Priyom 
Senior Solutions Manager — Redwood Inference
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Maya Singh <maya@fastretail.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekend launch — temporary cap request

Maya — thanks for the MAP and the heads-up. We can do a provisional protection package with the following headline items: 1) 48-hour provisional headroom cap (10x baseline) with priority routing for /checkout and /payments; 2) one-time smoothing credit up to $7k to cover shortfall from overages; 3) staged throttling with explicit early-warning hooks and an agreed runbook; 4) short amendment + exhibit (SLA-priority-routing) to be executed before the window.

Next steps: Ben will send the commercial amendment and credit note; Priyom will attach the routing exhibit and telemetry checklist; we need FastRetail to confirm the billing contact and sign the amendment by EOD Thursday to hit internal legal/ops cutoffs. Can we lock a 30-minute call tomorrow at 11am PT to finalize?

If that works I’ll also open a priority ticket with our SRE team so they can monitor the rollout and execute the staged throttle if required.

Cheers,
Jonas
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
